summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.43/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.43 a gallon across Wisconsin as of October 25, 2026, according to GasBuddy — the highest in WPR's 7 months of tracking. AAA figures put the statewide average 31¢ higher than a week ago, 17¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.71 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Eau Claire ($4.07) and the highest in Marshfield ($4.70).
